integrity: The result has an analytic proof and reproducible diagnostics; numerical tests are not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact Gaussian independent fresh-row and measurement redraws, norm-power selection, unregularized projections; squared-norm risk constants only for exponent two. The novelty assessment is subject to independently checking specialized stochastic projection literature.
title: Sharp moment spectrum and stationary risk of Gaussian streaming Kaczmarz
